media_distribution: AMI media is not redistributed with MeetingToM. Users must obtain authorized access to the AMI Meeting Corpus separately and reconstruct benchmark media locally using the provided metadata and scripts.

state.description: Reconstruct the target participant's close-up view.

state.Q2: Last 5 seconds of the source window.

you.description: Q1 uses the Corner view. Q2 uses a 2x2 mosaic of Closeup1, Closeup2, Closeup3, and Closeup4.

consensus.description: Both questions use a 2x2 mosaic of Closeup1, Closeup2, Closeup3, and Closeup4.
